B0600.title: Mirror Adjustment Driver Side Circuit
B0600.description: The driver side mirror adjustment circuit is malfunctioning. Mirror motor or position sensor fault.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0601.title: Mirror Adjustment Passenger Side Circuit
B0601.description: The passenger side mirror adjustment circuit is malfunctioning.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0610.title: Mirror Heater Circuit
B0610.description: A fault has been detected in the heated mirror circuit. Mirrors will not defog.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
